questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed allowed on that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit depending on weather, traffic, or road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Then go only if it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout before entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a full stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle and slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward to signal riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a sharp turn coming up. Reduce your speed before the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals always have the same order. Red is on top and green is on bottom for vertical signals. Red is on the left and green is on the right for horizontal signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn you of upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you there is low overhead clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intent to turn or stop. When the left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it means you are turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.
